A1.justification: Both PDFs describe GeoDiT and support reliable comparison of text, equations, tables and figures. v1 includes supplementary Sections 6–8; inspection confirms these are absent from v2 rather than unreadable.

before.justification: v1 reports original benchmark results, masking and timestep ablations, and qualitative generation examples in Tables 2–6 and Figures 4–8.

after.justification: v2 retains the original benchmark results and ablations in Tables 2–6, plus qualitative results in Figures 4–5.

M1.justification: Sections 3.1–3.4 retain the SigLIP-2/MLP/LLaDA-8B architecture, masked-token objective, two-stage training and iterative low-confidence remasking. Removing supplementary implementation explanations does not establish a changed algorithm.

E1.justification: SkyScript and optical MMRS-1M training coverage and the captioning, grounding, detection, VQA and classification benchmarks remain unchanged. The omitted supplementary illustrations are additional examples within the existing remote-sensing captioning task.

E2.justification: Tables 2–4 retain the same commercial, diffusion-based and autoregressive comparator membership in each experiment. Table 5 also retains the random-remasking comparator.

E3.justification: The retained protocols, metrics, one-epoch training stages, global batch sizes of 96/24, eight-step default inference and response-length limits are unchanged. Supplementary settings are omitted without specifying replacement settings or a revised experimental procedure.

E4.justification: v2 removes supplementary Section 8 and Figures 6–8, which examine hierarchical token generation in mixed-land-use, airport and rural scenes. The masking and timestep ablations and main qualitative analyses remain unchanged.

E5.justification: Both versions report point estimates without experimental run counts, random seeds, confidence intervals, error bars or formal significance tests. No statistical reporting practice changes.

E6.justification: The three supplementary caption-generation outputs and token-finalization visualizations are removed. Numerical results in Tables 2–6 remain unchanged, including RSICD CIDEr 135.6 and DIOR-RSVG detection mAP@0.5 of 20.8.

T1.justification: Removing supplementary Section 6 drops the explicit remasking-count definition m_k = ceil(gamma(t_k) * L). The numbered architecture, training-loss and decoding equations (1)–(7) remain unchanged; no theorem or proof changes.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same first-geospatial-diffusion-model positioning, claimed structural advantage over autoregressive generation and state-of-the-art performance claims. The added resource link does not alter these contributions.

C2.justification: Sections 4.2–4.4 preserve the interpretations concerning autoregressive duplication, hierarchical generation and timestep saturation. The removed supplementary discussion reiterates these mechanisms; no distinct limitation or applicability boundary is revised.

D1.justification: Supplementary Sections 6–7 are removed, losing substantial unique reproducibility information: the cosine remasking schedule, vision-encoder learning rate of 2e-6, anyres image patching, 8192-token model length, precision settings and distributed-training configuration. Basic settings remain in Section 3.4. v2 adds a repository resource link, whose contents are not established by the supplied PDFs.

R1.justification: The same 52 references and substantive related-work discussion are retained, including the positioning of GeoDiT as a geospatial adaptation of LLaDA-based diffusion generation. Reference backlink changes do not alter research positioning.

P1.justification: v2 revises the author and affiliation block, adds Qipeng Wang and an acknowledgments section, adds a resource sentence, and makes limited punctuation edits. Supplementary Sections 6–8 are omitted, while the main narrative and section organization remain substantially unchanged.

P2.justification: Supplementary Figures 6–8 and their captions disappear. Main Figures 1–5 and Tables 1–6 retain their content and design; the revised author block and added acknowledgments cause limited layout reflow.

improvement.justification: v2 loses unique implementation settings and three supporting generation examples without strengthening the retained experiments or explanations. The new resource link improves access information, but the PDFs do not establish that it restores the omitted material. With the core method, quantitative evidence and basic settings intact, the overall decline is limited mainly to reproducibility and supporting detail.
